north-london-action-for-the-homeless.n: North London Action for the Homeless

a: women at the well kings cross

opps.title: Lunch Service Volunteer
opps.what_youd_do: Chop vegetables, lay the tables, serve lunch to between 140 and 170 people, then clear down. The head chef shows you the ropes if you have never worked a kitchen.
opps.specific_times: 9.30am to 3pm, Monday to Friday

screening.induction: The head chef trains you on the job. Lunch is provided.

unsupported_fields: specific_times and typical_shift_hours come from volunteer.lambeth.gov.uk, not their own page

opps.title: Volunteer Mentor
opps.what_youd_do: Meet one LGBTQ+ young person for an hour a week. Their volunteers say empathy and being reliably there matters more than having lived it yourself.
opps.specific_times: About an hour a week

screening.induction: Induction to the organisation plus role-specific training

opps.title: Pride and Fundraising Events
opps.what_youd_do: Walk with them in a Pride parade, represent them at an event, or talk about their work at your local school.
opps.specific_times: Once a year for a Pride parade

opps.title: Volunteer Mentor
opps.what_youd_do: Be matched with one young person and stay with them for a year, working on whatever they are aiming at — work, learning, health, moving on. Their own mentors say reliability matters more than anything else.

screening.induction: Investing in Volunteers accredited since 2024. A discussion meeting about the role before you start.

unsupported_fields: min_term_months: the one-year match is described in an NCVO case study of their programme, not on their own page
status: their FAQ says roles are recruited as young people need them, and no live listing was found

opps.title: Helpline Volunteer
opps.what_youd_do: Answer their national helpline for under-25s who are homeless or about to be — calls, emails and web chats.

screening.induction: Investing in Volunteers accredited since 2024. A discussion meeting about the role before you start.

unsupported_fields: role detail comes from the vInspired platform, which is no longer operating, so it may not reflect current roles

opps.title: Welcome and Reception
opps.what_youd_do: Be the first face someone meets at a Skylight — making people feel safe and expected as they come through the door.
opps.specific_times: During the Skylight's opening hours, so staff are there if you need them

screening.induction: Essential learning first: safeguarding, equality and diversity, data protection. A named supervisor throughout.

unsupported_fields: status: their page says roles appear on the live board only when a Skylight has vacancies, so availability is not stated here

opps.title: One-to-One Member Support
opps.what_youd_do: Work with one member over several months on whatever they are trying to sort out, keeping their Skylight team updated as you go.

screening.induction: Essential learning first: safeguarding, equality and diversity, data protection. A named supervisor throughout.

unsupported_fields: status: their page says roles appear on the live board only when a Skylight has vacancies, so availability is not stated here
min_term_months and the DBS come from a Crisis Skylight Brent advert on their volunteering board, not the policy page

opps.title: Charity Shop Volunteer
opps.what_youd_do: Style the displays, sort stock, serve customers, make content for their social media. No references needed for this one.

screening.induction: Essential learning first: safeguarding, equality and diversity, data protection. A named supervisor throughout.

unsupported_fields: status: their page says roles appear on the live board only when a Skylight has vacancies, so availability is not stated here
screening.dbs: their policy says only some roles need a check; it does not say shop roles need none

opps.title: Nightstop Host
opps.what_youd_do: Give a young person with nowhere to go a spare room for the night, an evening meal, breakfast and a packed lunch to leave with.
opps.specific_times: Nights you pick yourself, on a flexible rota

screening.induction: Home visit, DBS check and training on youth homelessness, boundaries and safeguarding

eligibility: People with a spare room

opps.title: Nightstop Driver
opps.what_youd_do: Drive or travel with a young person to the host who is putting them up, and keep them company on what is usually a bad day.
opps.specific_times: Evenings, as and when you're free

screening.induction: Full training and ongoing support

opps.title: Retail Volunteer
opps.what_youd_do: Serve customers and refresh the displays in their charity shops — preloved fashion and retro furniture. Good if you like vintage, antiques or sustainability.
opps.specific_times: At least one full day a week, 9am to 5pm, on a day that suits you

screening.induction: A full induction including health and safety, then ongoing support from your manager and the companions.

eligibility: People aged 18 or over

opps.title: Street Souls Outreach
opps.what_youd_do: Go out with Street Souls, their outreach service for people sleeping rough or struggling with poverty across London.

screening.induction: A full induction including health and safety, then ongoing support from your manager and the companions.

eligibility: People aged 18 or over

opps.title: Furniture and Upcycling
opps.what_youd_do: Restore donated furniture in the workshop alongside the companions who live there. Woodwork and upcycling rather than a shop floor.

screening.induction: A full induction including health and safety, then ongoing support from your manager and the companions.

eligibility: People aged 18 or over

opps.title: Winter Night Shelter Volunteer
opps.what_youd_do: Help set up a church-hall shelter for the evening, cook and serve a hot meal, and welcome guests as they arrive.
opps.specific_times: Around 6pm to 9pm, the same evening each week, early November to April

screening.induction: Supported by a volunteer coordinator; chance to complete Level 2 Food Safety and Hygiene

opps.title: Drop-in Centre Support
opps.what_youd_do: Support caseworkers at partner day centres where guests come for advice and practical help.

opps.title: Lived Experience Group
opps.what_youd_do: Use your own experience of homelessness to shape how services are run and help the people coming through now.

opps.title: Homeless Health Peer Advocate
opps.what_youd_do: Go with someone to their health appointments — speak for them in the room, help them understand what they are told, and decide what happens next. For people who have been homeless themselves.
opps.specific_times: At least two days a week, plus monthly team meetings

screening.induction: Four weeks of training first, then monthly supervision

eligibility: People with lived experience of homelessness, addiction, recovery or prison

opps.title: Participation Volunteer
opps.what_youd_do: Sit on a group that uses its own experience of homelessness to change how services work — sharing insight with partners, designing solutions, building campaigns.
opps.specific_times: A regular group meeting

screening.induction: You can step back at any point, and your benefits will not be affected

eligibility: People with lived experience of homelessness

opps.title: Wrap Up London Coat Collection
opps.what_youd_do: Spend a few hours at a Tube station — King's Cross, Liverpool Street, Moorgate, Waterloo or London Bridge — taking donated winter coats from commuters.
opps.specific_times: November into early December

opps.title: Community Day
opps.what_youd_do: Pick a single day from their calendar. Recent projects have ranged from cooking and deliveries to befriending and gardening.
opps.specific_times: Varies — a couple of hours up to a full day

screening.induction: You need to register an account to see and book the calendar

opps.title: Citadel Volunteer
opps.what_youd_do: Walk alongside someone who has just been housed, so it holds. Keeping a tenancy is a different problem from getting one, and this is the part most schemes skip. North, north-east and south-east London.
opps.specific_times: One to two hours a week

screening.induction: Training and skills-building, and a group of other volunteers doing the same thing

opps.title: Volunteer Host
opps.what_youd_do: Take a destitute migrant into your spare room when they have nowhere safe at all. Housing Justice arrange the check and the immigration advice, and support you throughout.

screening.induction: They arrange your DBS check and provide immigration advice and ongoing support

eligibility: People with a spare room

opps.title: Winter Night Shelter
opps.what_youd_do: Work a night at a church shelter — welcoming guests, cooking, sitting up. Every night of the season, in Croydon and elsewhere across London.
opps.specific_times: Every night through the season

screening.induction: Induction and training sessions run by Housing Justice before the season starts

unsupported_fields: the January to April window and the Croydon venue come from londonslifelines.org, a partner site, for the 2026 season

opps.title: Kitchen Volunteer
opps.what_youd_do: Help in the kitchen at a day centre that opens every day of the week, including loading the dishwasher and clearing down.
opps.specific_times: 9.30am to 1.45pm, any day

screening.induction: You'll be added to a waiting list before a place comes up

opps.title: Computer Suite Volunteer
opps.what_youd_do: Sit with clients in the computer room and help with straightforward problems — the kind anyone who uses a computer could sort out.
opps.specific_times: 10.00am to 1.15pm, Monday to Friday

opps.title: Kitchen Volunteer
opps.what_youd_do: Work beside their chef on up to a hundred meals a day, vegetarian and meat, then keep the kitchen straight afterwards.
eligibility: Students enrolled at a UK or EU university, aged 18 or over

unsupported_fields: the role descriptions come from studentsunionucl.org, UCL's student volunteering platform, not their own page
status: no live volunteer listing found on their site or elsewhere

opps.title: ESOL Tutor
opps.what_youd_do: Run a weekly English conversation class for young people improving their spoken English — planning the topics and pitching them across a wide range of abilities.
eligibility: Students enrolled at a UK or EU university, aged 18 or over

unsupported_fields: the role descriptions come from studentsunionucl.org, UCL's student volunteering platform, not their own page
status: no live volunteer listing found on their site or elsewhere

opps.title: Sports Assistant
opps.what_youd_do: Help run their sports sessions — basketball, yoga, boxing or football. A coaching qualification is welcome, enthusiasm will do.
eligibility: Students enrolled at a UK or EU university, aged 18 or over

unsupported_fields: the role descriptions come from studentsunionucl.org, UCL's student volunteering platform, not their own page
status: no live volunteer listing found on their site or elsewhere

opps.title: Drop-in Meal Service
opps.what_youd_do: Cook and serve a three-course vegetarian meal at the table to between 50 and 150 people, then hand out take-away food and clothing to whoever asks.
opps.specific_times: Monday lunch from noon; Wednesday evening — check the time

screening.induction: Download their form and email it back; they tell you which roles are going

unsupported_fields: specific_times: their own pages give the Wednesday supper as 6pm and as 7pm

opps.title: Supplies Driver
opps.what_youd_do: Collect supplies for the drop-in in your own car or van. Occasional rather than regular — they ask when they need it.
opps.specific_times: Occasional, as and when they need a run

opps.title: Welcome Host
opps.what_youd_do: First person anyone meets in the welcome area at the Dellow Centre. Greeting people, making the room easy to walk into, pointing them to the right worker.
opps.specific_times: 8.30am to 11.30am or 11.30am to 2.30pm, Monday to Friday

screening.induction: A short chat, then a tour, then a taster day before you start

opps.title: Garden Volunteer
opps.what_youd_do: Work on the rooftop garden at the Dellow Centre. Outdoor, hands-on, and the sort of job that visibly looks better when you leave.

opps.title: Community Shop Volunteer
opps.what_youd_do: Serve customers, sort stock, dress the window, or go out in the van collecting donations. Twelve shops across north and west London, from Crouch End to Turnham Green.
opps.specific_times: A few hours a week, or a one-off event

screening.induction: Full training, an induction and a volunteer agreement. Expenses reimbursed; volunteering does not affect benefits.

eligibility: People aged 14 or over, with a parent or carer's consent under 18
People based in England, Scotland or Wales

unsupported_fields: the shop opportunity list is on app.betterimpact.com, the volunteering platform they use, not their own page

opps.title: Shop Volunteer Supervisor
opps.what_youd_do: Help run one of the shops — supporting the other volunteers, working the till systems, being the person people ask. No shop experience needed.

screening.induction: Full training, an induction and a volunteer agreement. Expenses reimbursed; volunteering does not affect benefits.

eligibility: People aged 18 or over
People based in England, Scotland or Wales

unsupported_fields: screening.min_age: 18 is their stated floor for supervisory roles rather than shop floor
the opportunity list is on app.betterimpact.com, the volunteering platform they use, not their own page

opps.title: Community Volunteer
opps.what_youd_do: Raise funds, collect donations and talk about their work. You choose whether that means events, speaking at community groups, or a bit of both.
opps.specific_times: Weekly, a one-off event, or anywhere between

screening.induction: Full training, an induction and a volunteer agreement. Expenses reimbursed; volunteering does not affect benefits.

eligibility: People aged 18 or over
People based in England, Scotland or Wales

opps.title: Hub Support
opps.what_youd_do: Work inside a local hub with their legal, housing rights or support services teams — admin or direct client support.

screening.induction: Full training, an induction and a volunteer agreement. Expenses reimbursed; volunteering does not affect benefits.

eligibility: People aged 18 or over
People based in England, Scotland or Wales

opps.title: Street Work
opps.what_youd_do: Walk a set route through central London handing out food, hot drinks, clothes and toiletries to people sleeping out. About two hours, and most of their volunteers do this one.
opps.specific_times: Early morning tea runs and late evening street work; nine services a week

screening.induction: No formal rule, but they suggest coming once every week or two

opps.title: Minibus Driver
opps.what_youd_do: Drive the minibus on their outreach services. They are always short of drivers.
eligibility: People aged 25 or over, with a clean licence

unsupported_fields: typical_shift_hours: inferred from the street work route

opps.title: Live-in Volunteer
opps.what_youd_do: Move into their house in Camden and live alongside previously homeless residents, running the outreach services together. Board, food, travel and bills are all covered, and you get time off in a separate house.
opps.specific_times: Full time, six to twelve months, living on site

screening.induction: All living expenses covered: board, food, travel and bills, in central London

eligibility: People aged 19 or over

unsupported_fields: min_term_months and the expenses detail are corroborated by CharityJob and VolunteerMatch listings rather than stated on their own page

opps.title: Social Media, Bids and Procurement
opps.what_youd_do: Lend them a professional skill — social media, procurement or bid writing. A few hours is enough.
opps.specific_times: A few hours, whenever you have them

opps.title: Peer Mentor
opps.what_youd_do: Use your own recovery to guide someone through theirs. Over forty Londoners graduate as Peer Mentors a year, and many go on to work here afterwards.

screening.induction: Accredited training, run throughout the year, with ongoing support

eligibility: Londoners with lived experience of homelessness, substance use or the justice system
People six months clear of substances, serious mental health episodes or offending

unsupported_fields: boroughs: the programme runs in Camden, Islington and Westminster, which the schema records only at organisation level

opps.title: Skills-Based Volunteering
opps.what_youd_do: Give them a skill they cannot buy — fitness instruction, IT support, training, design, PR. One-off or regular, on your own or with colleagues.
opps.specific_times: One-off or regular, as it suits you

opps.title: Rape Crisis Helpline
opps.what_youd_do: Take calls on the North London Rape Crisis helpline, giving emotional support and information to women who have experienced sexual violence. Office or remote.

screening.induction: Solace induction and their internal volunteer training. Spent convictions must be declared.

eligibility: Women, trans women included — exempt under the Equality Act 2010, Schedule 9

unsupported_fields: status: their role description is dated January 2024 and no live listing was found
postcode_district: the service is Camden-based but the role is part remote
specific_times: they state half a day a week but no time of day

opps.title: Fundraising Volunteer
opps.what_youd_do: Help raise money for their work across south-west London. They say they welcome applications from everyone, and particularly from people who have been homeless themselves.

screening.induction: A thorough induction, ongoing training and support, and they tell you what your help achieved

unsupported_fields: their page says roles change frequently, so this list may be short-lived

opps.title: Rough Sleeper Drop-In
opps.what_youd_do: Cook and serve breakfast at a weekday morning drop-in, in a church hall in Tooting, West Norwood or Streatham. Showers and clothing run alongside it.
opps.specific_times: 9am to 11.30am; Mon Tooting, Tue and Fri West Norwood, Thu Streatham

screening.induction: You choose your own days. They ask for at least three hours a month.

opps.title: Women's Outreach
opps.what_youd_do: Night outreach with the women's team, working with women involved in street-based sex work. Four sessions a week, on personal and sexual safety.
opps.specific_times: Four night sessions a week; at least three hours a month

screening.induction: Health and safety training, then shadowing shifts until both you and the team are ready

opps.title: Women's Space
opps.what_youd_do: Support the twice-weekly women-only drop-in at their Stockwell office — a room where women who would not use a mixed centre will come.
opps.specific_times: Thursdays, 9am to noon

screening.induction: You choose your own days. They ask for at least three hours a month.

unsupported_fields: activity: their schedule confirms the session, not what a volunteer does in it

opps.title: Paper and Cup Coffee Shop
opps.what_youd_do: Front of house at their coffee shop in Shoreditch — making drinks and working the till. It doubles as a training ground for baristas in recovery from addiction.

screening.induction: Induction and training. A caution or conviction does not necessarily bar you.

opps.title: Restoration Station
opps.what_youd_do: Restore and upcycle furniture alongside people in recovery, in a workshop that also collaborates with local artists.

screening.induction: Induction and training. A caution or conviction does not necessarily bar you.

opps.title: Charity Shop Volunteer
opps.what_youd_do: Till, stockroom and sorting in one of their eight East London shops — Hackney, Bethnal Green, Roman Road, Aldgate East, Watney Market or Leytonstone. A few hours is enough.
opps.specific_times: A few hours, whenever suits

screening.induction: Induction and training. A caution or conviction does not necessarily bar you.

opps.title: Head Office, Fundraising or Communications
opps.what_youd_do: Put a professional skill to work behind the scenes — their head office, fundraising and communications teams all take volunteers.

screening.induction: Induction and training. A caution or conviction does not necessarily bar you.

opps.title: Outreach Volunteer, Westminster
opps.what_youd_do: Walk shifts with the outreach workers in Westminster — navigating, assessing, taking notes, and helping people towards immigration, work or a bed. Expect long distances.
opps.specific_times: Early 6am to 10am or late 8.30pm to midnight, any day; one shift a month minimum

screening.induction: Two-hour online core training. They ask about spent convictions. Travel refunded to zones 1-6.

unsupported_fields: recruitment may close early depending on the volume of applications

opps.title: Outreach Volunteer, Brent
opps.what_youd_do: The same outreach work in Brent, early mornings only. They would rather you lived in the borough, given the hour.
opps.specific_times: 6am to 10am, Monday to Friday; weekly, fortnightly or monthly

screening.induction: Two-hour online core training. They ask about spent convictions. Travel refunded to zones 1-6.

unsupported_fields: recruitment may close early depending on the volume of applications

opps.title: Outreach Volunteer, Ealing
opps.what_youd_do: Outreach in Ealing, either a Monday late shift or a Wednesday and Friday very early one. You need to be able to drive for this one.
opps.specific_times: Monday 10pm to 2am, or Wednesday and Friday 5am to 8am

screening.induction: Two-hour online core training. They ask about spent convictions. Travel refunded to zones 1-6.

unsupported_fields: recruitment may close early depending on the volume of applications

opps.title: First Response
opps.what_youd_do: Go out with a partner volunteer to find people reported sleeping rough through StreetLink, and pass what you learn to the outreach team so they can act faster.

screening.induction: Two-hour online core training. They ask about spent convictions. Travel refunded to zones 1-6.

opps.title: Gardening Sessions
opps.what_youd_do: Run regular gardening sessions for their clients. Somewhere between horticulture and company, and it counts as both.

screening.induction: Two-hour online core training. They ask about spent convictions. Travel refunded to zones 1-6.

opps.title: Online Support Volunteer
opps.what_youd_do: Work an online shift from home, on the platform they train you on, helping LGBTQ+ people facing homelessness. A supervisor is with you for every shift.

screening.induction: Training on the platform, a supervisor on every shift, and ongoing supervision from their Volunteer Coordinator

skills: your own computer, tablet or phone
eligibility: People aged 18 or over, living in the UK

opps.title: Volunteering in their Services
opps.what_youd_do: Work alongside their street outreach, hostel, supported housing or employment teams. They are open that volunteering here is often a first step into a paid job in the sector.

screening.induction: A one-day core training covering safeguarding and boundaries. Travel expenses paid.

unsupported_fields: screening.induction: the one-day training and expenses come from a Team London listing, not their own page, and that listing still refers to COVID lockdowns

opps.title: Frontline Office Volunteer
opps.what_youd_do: Work in their London frontline office — admin, and the front desk where vendors come in for magazines and for help with whatever else is going on.

screening.induction: Training in safeguarding, health and safety and data protection. Some roles ask for a reference.

unsupported_fields: screening.references: they ask for one on some roles but do not say which
the volunteering page is on bigissue.com, Big Issue Group's own domain, while the Foundation's site is bigissue.org.uk; the page also sits under a corporate path though the copy addresses individuals

opps.title: Events Support
opps.what_youd_do: Help set up and run their fundraising events, and attend them free. The only role on their list open to an individual off the street.
opps.specific_times: Half a day to a day, ad hoc through the year

opps.title: Day Centre, for Partner Companies
opps.what_youd_do: Serve food in the catering service, run artistic activities with the people they support, or help at Christmas. 627 corporate volunteers did this last year.
eligibility: Companies that are financial partners of the charity

opps.title: Kitchen Support Volunteer
opps.what_youd_do: Work in a team of six under one of the chefs, preparing and serving food at the day centre. Standing throughout, with lifting and carrying.

screening.induction: Full induction and training; travel expenses reimbursed

opps.title: Clothing Store and Laundry Volunteer
opps.what_youd_do: Help run the laundry and clothing store, working directly with people who come in for a shower, clean clothes and a wash.
opps.specific_times: Shifts booked on an online rota; weekly or fortnightly

screening.induction: Full induction and training; travel expenses reimbursed

opps.title: Irish Weekly Group Volunteer
opps.what_youd_do: Help run the weekly Irish group, making it a warm and easy room to walk into for the clients who come.
opps.specific_times: Wednesday afternoons, 1pm to 3pm

screening.induction: Full induction and training; travel expenses reimbursed

opps.title: Sports and Activities Volunteer
opps.what_youd_do: Support clients to take part in sport, fitness and social activities, across the day centre and venues around Westminster.
opps.specific_times: Depends on the activity schedule and your availability

screening.induction: Full induction and training; travel expenses reimbursed

opps.title: Reception Volunteer, Passage House
opps.what_youd_do: Front desk at a hostel for people who were rough sleeping in Westminster with no local connection. Mostly talking to people and making them feel safe.

screening.induction: Full induction and training; travel expenses reimbursed

opps.title: Barber, Afro-Textured Hair Specialist
opps.what_youd_do: Cut and style afro-textured hair once a month or so. A fresh haircut does more for someone's morale than almost anything else here.
opps.specific_times: Once a month or fortnight

screening.induction: Full induction and training; travel expenses reimbursed

opps.title: Women's Hairdresser
opps.what_youd_do: Cut and style women's hair of all types. The role exists because women using the service asked for a hairdresser they felt comfortable with. Bring your own equipment; chairs and capes provided.

screening.induction: Full induction and training; travel expenses reimbursed

opps.title: Station Collector
opps.what_youd_do: Stand with a collecting tin at Victoria or another London station and talk to passers-by. Collections run between 7am and 10pm.
opps.specific_times: Between 7am and 10pm, monthly collections

screening.induction: Full induction and training; travel expenses reimbursed

opps.title: Breakfast Challenge
opps.what_youd_do: Bring a group from your workplace to prepare and serve the morning meal alongside regular staff. Very early start.
opps.specific_times: From 5.45am, any day of the year

screening.induction: First-time groups visit the site beforehand. Not suitable in the third trimester of pregnancy.

opps.title: Clothing Challenge
opps.what_youd_do: Bring a group to work through sacks of donated clothing — sorting, measuring, tagging and hanging items ready to be given out.

screening.induction: First-time groups visit the site beforehand. Not suitable in the third trimester of pregnancy.

opps.title: Volunteering in their Services
opps.what_youd_do: Support one of their services — The Haven day centre or St Luke's. Their page does not set out individual roles; you name the one you want on the application form after talking to the service.

screening.induction: An informal discussion with the service first, then an application form

unsupported_fields: status: the closure notice is headed 'COVID-19 update' and may be years old — worth ringing the service

opps.title: Drop-In Kitchen
opps.what_youd_do: Make conversation and a toasted sandwich at the same time. Hands-on training plus a certified food hygiene course before you start.
opps.specific_times: 12.30pm to 3.30pm, one regular day a week, Monday to Thursday

screening.induction: Hands-on training and a certified online food hygiene course before your first shift

eligibility: Women — a women-only service, exempt under the Sex Discrimination Act 1975

opps.specific_times: 12.30pm to 3.30pm, one regular day a week, Monday to Thursday

screening.induction: Most volunteers here stay about four years

eligibility: Women — a women-only service, exempt under the Sex Discrimination Act 1975

opps.title: Drop-In Reception
opps.what_youd_do: Run the reception desk — greeting the women who come in, answering calls, booking appointments.
opps.specific_times: 12.30pm to 3.30pm, one regular day a week, Monday to Thursday

screening.induction: Most volunteers here stay about four years
